summary: y is spherical at w (w is off level) and each T_{w,i} acts by p(w, i).

steps.claim: y has the principal level at the chosen places, whose level group contains the maximal compact subgroups at w and w̄ (w is off level: maxCompactAt_le_levelOf, levelSpace_anti), so y is spherical at w; and T_{w,i} y = p(w, i)·y for every i because y lies in the eigenspace of D.heckeOperator (w, i) = T_{w,i} for p(w, i); hence the Hecke polynomial acts by Σ (−X)^i q^{i(i−1)/2} p(w, i) (isSphericalWith_of_heckeSplit).
steps.lean:
isSphericalWith_of_heckeSplit (levelSpace_anti (maxCompactAt_le_levelOf h.2) y.2)
  (by simpa [heckeOperator, h, Subtype.ext_iff] using (mem_iInf _).1 hy ⟨w, ·⟩)
